actions.diff:
--- a/minbpe/regex.py
+++ b/minbpe/regex.py
@@ -99,19 +99,36 @@
-            p0, p1 = pair
-            touched = []
-            where_idx = where[idx]
-            for k in where[p0] & where[p1]:
-                old = ids[k]
-                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
-                if len(new) == len(old):
-                    continue
-                ids[k] = new
-                w = weights[k]
-                for p in zip(old, old[1:]):
-                    stats[p] -= w
-                    touched.append(p)
-                for p in zip(new, new[1:]):
-                    stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + w
-                where_idx.add(k)
-            for p in touched:
-                if stats_get(p) == 0:
-                    del stats[p]
+            # (old/new pair counts are tallied per merge, in C for the common
+            # weight-1 chunks, then applied to stats once per distinct pair)
+            p0, p1 = pair
+            dec = {} # pair -> weighted count in the replaced chunks
+            inc = {} # pair -> weighted count in their merged versions
+            dec_get = dec.get
+            inc_get = inc.get
+            where_idx = where[idx]
+            for k in where[p0] & where[p1]:
+                old = ids[k]
+                new = merge(old, pair, idx)
+                if len(new) == len(old):
+                    continue
+                ids[k] = new
+                w = weights[k]
+                if w == 1:
+                    _count_elements(dec, zip(old, old[1:]))
+                    _count_elements(inc, zip(new, new[1:]))
+                else:
+                    for p in zip(old, old[1:]):
+                        dec[p] = dec_get(p, 0) + w
+                    for p in zip(new, new[1:]):
+                        inc[p] = inc_get(p, 0) + w
+                where_idx.add(k)
+            dec_pop = dec.pop
+            for p, c in inc.items():
+                c -= dec_pop(p, 0)
+                if c:
+                    # stays positive: c > 0 counts were added for p
+                    stats[p] = stats_get(p, 0) + c
+            for p, c in dec.items():
+                c = stats[p] - c
+                if c:
+                    stats[p] = c
+                else:
+                    del stats[p]
